name: Fluff n' Gutz
source:
In a world where the once inanimate are ensouled, the fateful night of Halloween awakens those who were made to frighten.

Kyu is a live teddy bear who suddenly got assigned a shift at the high security ward after the previous nurse mysteriously vanished, but overstayed his welcome and ended up getting locked in for the night.

Can he survive the infamous Halloween night in this ward? Especially when a mysterious other teddy bear offers him safety, only to potentially be the biggest threat of them all?

[From [url=https://michikani.itch.io/fluff-n-gutz]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一个昔日死物皆被赋予灵魂的世界里，宿命般的万圣节之夜唤醒了那些生来便只为散播恐惧的存在。

小九是一只活生生的泰迪熊，在前任护士离奇失踪后被临时指派到高度戒备病房值班，谁知因逗留过久，竟在夜里被反锁在了病房之中。

他能否在这间臭名昭著的病房里熬过万圣节之夜？尤其是当另一只神秘的泰迪熊主动向他提供庇护，却恰恰可能是全场最致命的威胁之时？

[摘自[url=https://michikani.itch.io/fluff-n-gutz]itch.io[/url]]
